name: Artlist
summary: Connect your personal Artlist account, browse your library, preview music and sound effects and add authorized originals and stock footage to a Draft.

compatibility.selects: Requires music.artlist.web-session.v1 and a personal Artlist web login. Free accounts support previews only. Artlist Social Monthly Music MP3 and SFX WAV downloads, plus, cover drag, playback, WAV export and MP4 export were verified on macOS; Windows remains unverified. Website changes can break this unpublished prototype; permission for public distribution remains unresolved.
